world: a vast misty swamp deep in an ancient jungle, murky green-black water with rotting logs and giant lily pads, twisted mangrove roots and hanging moss, pale purple poison mist drifting low over the water, glowing toxic mushrooms and bubbling mud pools, broken stone ruins half sunk in the bog, dim greenish light filtering through a heavy canopy

b-bogfrog.describe: a fat mud-covered swamp toad as big as a dog, warty olive-green skin with purple poison spots, bulging yellow eyes, wide grinning mouth with a long sticky tongue, sitting on a mossy log in shallow murky water, drops of poisonous slime dripping from its chin, a little dopey but sly expression

b-mantis.describe: a towering emerald praying mantis warrior taller than a man, armored jade-green carapace with leaf-like edges, two huge scythe forearms gleaming like polished blades, sharp triangular head with cold compound eyes, wings half spread like torn leaves, poised to strike among tall reeds and hanging vines

b-hydra.describe: a colossal three-headed swamp hydra rising from the bog, long serpentine necks covered in dark moss-green scales and dripping slime, each head with glowing violet eyes and fangs exhaling purple poison mist, a crest of jagged fins, massive coiled body half submerged in black water, ancient and terrifying, looming over sunken stone ruins
